description: This source file defines the OpenmrsObjectValueBridge class, which implements a Hibernate Search ValueBridge to index OpenmrsObject instances by their ID as strings. It is part of the Hibernate search integration for the OpenMRS platform, specifically in the package for search bridge implementations.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectValueBridge
classes.description: Implements a Hibernate Search ValueBridge that indexes OpenmrsObject instances by their ID as string values.

methods.name: toIndexedValue
methods.description: Converts an OpenmrsObject instance to its string ID representation for indexing.
